summary: fractal-web accepts fractal envelope schema spellings alongside st3 spellings without changing writers.

schema.detail: No database schema or registry name change.

compatibility.detail: Additive web readers accept fractal subject schema-id prefixes, fractal.client.v0 native usage envelopes, and fractal.client.v0/usage.period provenance beside their existing st3 spellings. Exact renderer selection and registration conflicts treat the two schema namespaces as aliases without renaming registered keys. Unknown namespaces and versions remain refused. Requests and locally projected provenance keep their existing st3 spelling; no server writer changes.

recovery.detail: No recovery change; existing spellings remain readable.
